name: veneno - [MMMM]
description:
veneno is difficult to physically treat, and I would advise you to make antitoxins a permanent part of your repertoire. There are many different types, some with the potential to harm the sensitive structures in your ears, liver, or even your blood
itself. Remember not to induce vomiting unless Você está certain the veneno is not also corrosive.

results.description:
Roll to randomly determine your left or right ear. The veneno has spread to the delicate structures in your inner ear. This ear is não funcional, and if not treated dentro de 12 horas, your hearing will be damaged beyond repair (and be considered ausente).

Tratamento - A DC 20 Save Sense Surgery.
results.name: Ototoxicity

results.description: You feel dizzy, the world seems to be shifting under your feet. The problem only gets worse when you're near a great height. Você tem Disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks. Você tem Disadvantage on all attacks and ability checks when Você está dentro de 5 feet of a height 15 feet or greater.
results.name: Vertigo

results.description: When the veneno has run its course Você está left with a permanent weakness. Your carrying capacity is reduced by half.
results.name: Anemic

results.description:
The veneno is particularly strong and you can't seem to shake free of it. Você está &Reference[Poisoned]{Poisoned} for [[1d6]] dias.

Tratamento - After each long rest you may make a Constitution Saving Throw (DC equals half the dano that caused the lesão persistente or 10, whichever number is higher). On a success, Você está no longer Poisoned. Any effect that cures veneno (such as the Lesser Restoration spell) instead temporarily suppresses the veneno for one hour.
results.name: Lingering veneno

results.description: You can feel your head pounding as the veneno pumps through your veins. Você recebe no Advantage from short rests até you take a long rest.
results.name: Splitting Headache

results.description:
You can physically feel the veneno eating away at you from the inside, and the adrenaline pumping through you is only helping to Force it throughout your body. At the beginning of your Turno you take veneno dano scaled to the dano that caused the lesão persistente: 1-10 dano ([[1d2]]), 11-20 dano ([[1d4]]), 21-30 dano ([[1d6]]), 31-40 dano ([[1d8]]), >40 dano ([[1d10]]). This effect continues até Você está off initiative.

Tratamento - Any spell or effect that cures the &Reference[Poisoned]{Poisoned} condition will end this effect.
results.name: Virulent veneno

results.description:
Your lips Turno blue, you're out of breath and you feel like you can't suck in enough air no matter how hard you try. You suffer three levels of &Reference[Exhaustion]{Exhaustion}.

Tratamento - You may remove these levels of Exhaustion with either a long or a short rest. Any spell or effect that removes one level of Exhaustion instead removes all three.
results.name: Cyanotic

results.description:
Your eyes cloud over, your vision blurs, and distinct shapes become amorphous blobs. Você tem Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on vision and all ranged attacks for [[1d4]] dias. If Você tem darkvision, you lose it for this duration.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d2]] dias.
results.name: Blurred Vision

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. The veneno has had the interesting effect of dying your skin. This area of your body has taken on a light shade the same colour as the veneno, or roll to determine the color randomly ([[1d4]]): 1) Green 2) Purple 3) Orange 4) Blue.
results.name: Residual Pigmentation

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. Your veins have been scarred in this area, leaving them slightly raised and pigmented the same color as the veneno, or roll to determine the color randomly ([[1d4]]): 1) Green 2) Grey 3) Red 4) Brown.
results.name: Scarred Veins

results.description: You feel a sick, oily feeling deep in your stomach and bile roiling up your throat. Você tem Disadvantage on all ability checks for [[1d6]] rodadas.
results.name: Nausea

results.description: You feel sick, and without warning, the last meal you ate is purged from your stomach. Você está &Reference[incapacitated]{incapacitated} até the end of your next Turno, and Você tem Disadvantage on all ability checks for [[1d2]] rodadas.
results.name: Vomiting

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. The veneno has interacted with your body in a thoroughly unexpected way, causing a strange alteration in appearance. This area of your body takes on a physical attribute somehow related to the source of the veneno (such as green scales from the veneno breath of a dragon). At the DM's discretion, this new attribute may give you a +1 bonus to an Ability Check.
results.name: Unexpected Mutagen

results.description: You feel hungry all the time, and it's very difficult for you to gain weight. You require double the normal amount of food and water per day.
results.name: Inefficient Metabolism

results.description: You hardly ever feel hungry, and it's very easy for you to gain weight. You require half the normal amount of food and water per day. Potions you use require one full minute to take effect instead of taking effect immediately.
results.name: Slowed Metabolism

results.description: The veneno has left your liver scarred and damaged. There's never been a better time to give up drinking. Any amount of alcohol you consume gives you the &Reference[Poisoned]{Poisoned} condition. Alcohol or other drugs affect you for double their normal duration. Você tem Disadvantage on any Constitution checks or saving throws made to resist veneno.
results.name: Liver Cirrhosis
